original.target_description: Original Van Ryzin (2013) Figure 6 regression-based path analysis: Performance → Satisfaction, controlling disconfirmation and expectations. CivicPanel international Internet-panel participants, predominantly United States; no Hong Kong or Shenzhen sample in this paper. This is the analogous original relationship, with a known sample mismatch to the supplied description.

notes: Published article version, 2013, pp. 597–614. Original side only. The supplied Hong Kong/Shenzhen sample descriptor belongs to no sample in this original source, so target_match is false. Numeric fields identify the corresponding theoretical link in the original Figure 6, not a Hong Kong/Shenzhen estimate. Figure 6 marks this direct coefficient *** with legend ***p < .01. The p. 607 statement of p < .001 explicitly concerns the core expectancy-disconfirmation relationships and is not extended to this direct path. No coefficient conversion performed.
